# ReAlto Partners

> ReAlto Partners is a culture-first organization of real estate agents at eXp Realty, founded and led by Dan Gomer and based in Highlands Ranch in the Denver metro area of Colorado. Tagline: "Empowering People Through Real Estate." It is a real estate team, not a brokerage (eXp Realty is the brokerage) and not related to any private equity firm named Alto Partners.

Key facts:
- Founder and team leader: Dan Gomer, a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, real estate investor since starting with fix and flips in Denver, in real estate since 2012, with eXp Realty since 2022, and author of "I'm Full of It and So Are You."
- Partner and podcast co-host: Allison Gomer, Dan's wife, a Colorado psychotherapist and ceremonial guide who offers cacao ceremonies, guided meditation and a nine-session Sacred Psychotherapy and Ceremony program (allisongomer.com).
- Mission: positively impact as many lives as possible using the vehicle of real estate.
- Vision: personal and financial freedom for every agent partner.
- Core values: culture is our heartbeat; service is the path to success; resourcefulness and resiliency; integrity in all actions; community and dependability.
- Weekly rhythm: Crush the Cap call Wednesdays 9:00 AM Mountain, team call Wednesdays 9:30 AM Mountain.
- Community: breakfasts and happy hours, quarterly charity events, masterminds, eXp Explained luncheons in Colorado Springs, an annual camping trip and an annual golf tournament.
- Areas served: Denver, Highlands Ranch, Douglas County, Colorado Springs and Colorado's Front Range; agents can join from anywhere eXp Realty operates.
- Phone: 303.261.5278
- Podcast: The Dan & Allison Gomer Podcast (now recording) on business, marriage, leadership, mindset, money, real estate and wellbeing.
- eXp Realty programs (revenue share, stock awards, splits and caps) are set by eXp Realty and change over time; earnings are not guaranteed.

# Frequently asked questions

## ReAlto Partners

### What is ReAlto Partners?
ReAlto Partners is a community of real estate agents at eXp Realty, founded and led by Dan Gomer in the Denver metro area of Colorado. Its mission is to positively impact as many lives as possible through real estate, and its vision is personal and financial freedom for every agent on the team.

### Is ReAlto Partners a real estate brokerage?
No. eXp Realty is the brokerage. ReAlto Partners is an organization of agents inside eXp Realty that adds culture, coaching, training and in-person community on top of eXp's cloud-based platform.

### Who leads ReAlto Partners?
Dan Gomer, a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, real estate investor and author of I'm Full of It and So Are You. His wife and partner, Allison Gomer, co-hosts their podcast.

### Where is ReAlto Partners located?
The team is based in Highlands Ranch in the Denver metro area and has agent partners along Colorado's Front Range, including Denver and Colorado Springs. Because eXp Realty is cloud based, agents can join from anywhere eXp operates.

### How do I join ReAlto Partners?
Fill out the short form on the Why ReAlto page or call Dan at 303.261.5278. The first step is a no-pressure conversation.

## Dan Gomer

### Who is Dan Gomer?
Dan Gomer is a Colorado real estate team leader at eXp Realty and the founder of ReAlto Partners. He is a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, a real estate investor, a speaker and the author of I'm Full of It and So Are You.

### What brokerage is Dan Gomer with?
Dan Gomer has been with eXp Realty since 2022. Before that he spent about ten years at Your Castle Real Estate in the Denver area.

### How did Dan Gomer get into real estate?
He started by flipping houses in Denver, then shifted his focus to helping people buy and sell homes and, later, to building a team that helps other agents grow.

### What is Dan Gomer's book about?
I'm Full of It and So Are You uses humor and real-life stories to show how the stories we tell about our past drive our decisions, and how to rewrite them to create the life you want.

## Allison Gomer and cacao ceremonies

### What is a cacao ceremony?
A cacao ceremony is a guided ritual built around drinking ceremonial cacao, a minimally processed form of the cacao bean, with intention. Allison pairs it with breathwork and guided meditation so the experience becomes a calm, heart-centered space to set intentions and reflect.

### What happens during one of Allison's cacao ceremonies?
Allison prepares a sacred space and altar, guides you in setting an intention, serves the cacao, leads breathwork and a guided meditation, and closes with a circle for sharing and integration.

### How long does a cacao ceremony last?
Allison's ceremonies typically last between 60 and 90 minutes. Private and group ceremonies include an intention call beforehand, and individual and duo ceremonies include a follow-up session.

### Who are the ceremonies for?
Anyone looking for a reset: individuals, couples, friends, groups of up to ten and corporate teams. No meditation experience is needed. Each ceremony is crafted for the person or group in the room.

### Where does Allison offer ceremonies?
Ceremonies are held in person in the Denver metro area of Colorado. Her nine-session Sacred Psychotherapy and Ceremony program combines in-person sessions with Zoom. Book through allisongomer.com.

### Is ceremonial cacao safe?
Ceremonial cacao is food, not a psychedelic. It does contain theobromine and a small amount of caffeine, which are mild stimulants. If you are pregnant, have a heart condition, or take antidepressants or other medications, check with your doctor before attending.

## Joining ReAlto Partners at eXp Realty

### Do ReAlto Partners agents ever meet in person?
All the time. Breakfasts, happy hours, quarterly charity events, masterminds, eXp Explained luncheons, an annual camping trip and a golf tournament with a traveling trophy. Cloud based just means we are intentional about it.

### How does support work on eXp's virtual platform?
Agents get fast access to managing brokers through eXp World, eXp's virtual campus, plus direct access to everyone in the ReAlto organization: teachers, former managing brokers, team leads, investors and multi-state agents.

### How does eXp Realty revenue share work?
eXp Realty shares a portion of company revenue with agents who attract other productive agents to the brokerage. It is paid by eXp, not taken from the other agent's commission. Program rules change over time, so Dan walks through the current plan on a call.

### Can I join ReAlto Partners if I am not in Colorado?
Yes. ReAlto is based in the Denver metro, but because eXp Realty is cloud based, agents licensed wherever eXp operates can join and take part in calls, trainings and masterminds online.

### I'm not sure what I'd bring to the team.
We believe everyone has a gift to give. If you are unsure what yours is, that is exactly what a first conversation is for.

### Is a call a commitment?
No. It is a chance to connect and get a feel for who we are. There is no obligation.

## The Dan & Allison Gomer Podcast

### Who hosts the Dan & Allison Gomer Podcast?
Husband and wife Dan Gomer, a real estate team leader at eXp Realty and author, and Allison Gomer, a psychotherapist and cacao ceremony facilitator.

### What is the podcast about?
Building a business, a marriage and a meaningful life at the same time: leadership, mindset, money, real estate, parenting, burnout and purpose, with guests who have lived it.

### When does the podcast launch?
The show is recording now. Join the episode alert list on this page to hear the first episode the day it is released.

### How can I be a guest?
Use the guest and topic form on this page to pitch yourself, recommend a guest or suggest a topic.

# Allison Gomer services
- Cacao ceremony (individual): A private ceremony with an intention-setting call beforehand, a 90 minute in-person cacao ceremony and a follow-up session.
- Cacao ceremony (duo): The same private ceremony experience shared by two people, such as partners, friends or family.
- Group cacao ceremony: A ceremony for groups of three to ten people with an intention call beforehand and follow-up support.
- Corporate and team ceremonies: Custom cacao and meditation experiences for teams, retreats and events.
- Sacred Psychotherapy and Ceremony: A nine-session program that combines talk therapy, somatic and chakra meditation, energy work and a closing mini cacao ceremony, over Zoom and in person.
- Guided meditation library: Recorded guided meditations and ceremonies to use at home (coming soon).
